values.question: Can you issue a company invoice and provide a no-photography notice?
values.answer: A company invoice can be issued; because the tour route includes an area with customer prototypes, a statement specifying photography boundaries must be signed.

values.question: By what time can the reserved spots be canceled without penalty?
values.answer: Cancellations made within three business days before the visit incur no fee, and the deposit will be refunded via the original payment method; cancellations within three days will forfeit half of the deposit.

values.question: How is settlement handled if the headcount temporarily decreases?
values.answer: Settlement is based on the actual attendance but may not be lower than 90% of the contracted headcount. Any reduction must be reported before 10:00 a.m. that day.
